name: Should I consider a detached ADU or a garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: Should I consider a detached ADU or a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between a detached ADU and a garage conversion depends on your property's layout, existing structures, and intended use for the new space. A detached ADU offers maximum privacy and design flexibility, while a garage conversion can be more cost-effective by utilizing an existing foundation and structure. We assess your site and discuss your vision to determine the most functional and valuable solution that enhances your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose between a detached ADU for maximum privacy and flexibility, or a garage conversion for potential cost savings and existing structure use.
